title: A noisy night
summary: An Apnea-ECG night with many missing or unusable beats, to show how the report marks stretches without enough usable data.
selection: Apnea-ECG record with the lowest fraction of valid RR intervals after cleaning (data/cache/record_summary.json).

source.note: Part of the apnea training set. It has no sleep-stage reference, so the hypnogram cannot be compared with a reference for this night.

title: A typical night
summary: The UCDDB night where the v2 total sleep time error is the median of the 25 UCDDB test nights: v2 estimates 5 h 9 min of sleep, the sleep lab scored 5 h 54 min.
selection: UCDDB record (primary analysis) whose v2 absolute total sleep time error is the median among UCDDB records (results/v2/test_results.json, per_record of sleep_wake v2); with an even count, the lower record id of the two middle records.

source.dataset: St. Vincent's University Hospital / University College Dublin Sleep Apnea Database (UCDDB)
source.note: Part of the v1 external test set and the v2 second look: neither model was trained or selected on this night. Reference sleep stages and apnea events exist for it.
